description: Starts checkout for One Design Pro and opens it in the browser. Only when the person asks to buy or upgrade, and only for the plan they chose: if they haven't said, ask "Pro monthly (£8.99 a month, cancel any time) or Lifetime (£49.99 once)?". Both can be bought signed out: Stripe asks for an email and the account is made or found from it, then sign_in with that email unlocks it here. Signed in, it goes on that account. A monthly Pro user can upgrade to Lifetime. Payment happens on Stripe’s page, never here.

open_in_browser.description: Open the checkout page in the default browser. Off: just return the link.

plan.description: monthly: Pro at £8.99 a month. lifetime: Pro for good, £49.99 once.
